decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B2_PROTOCOL_V1 for SW10-S2-B2 Causal Factor Validation & Semantic Audit. B2 uses point-in-time date-specific cross-sectional 80/20 tails; horizons 1/2/3/5/7/10; trading date as inference unit; Newey-West HAC with Bartlett kernel and lag=horizon-1; two-sided inference; BH-FDR q=0.05; four chronological stability blocks; 3-of-4 directional consistency; <=50% single-block absolute aggregate-effect concentration; symbol concentration and leave-top-five-out sign test; VOL_TURN_B1_LEGACY preserved and VOL_TURN_V2_CAUSAL defined as current volume divided by mean of prior 20 completed observations; explicit four-state disposition taxonomy; no optimization, holdout access, or S3 promotion from isolated B2 results.
evidence: Parent B1 MWE MWE-SW10-S2B1-001 completed with verified factor_tail_summary.csv; B1 exposed pooled full-panel qcut temporal semantics and VOL_TURN legacy-expression limitations that B2 must explicitly test without rewriting B1.
rationale: Freeze causal/statistical/semantic rules before B2 outcomes so discovery validation cannot be tuned after observing results.
title: S2-B2 causal validation protocol freeze
